decisions.reason: As a very recent launch with broad functionality, it still represents a valuable option and one year on the market is usually too little evidence for an established German machinery firm to abandon it.

This product overlaps partly with the combined robot, so its abandonment risk is higher, but management would likely keep it another year to learn whether customers prefer a dedicated de-shuttering solution.
As a complementary storage robot with no clear negative signal yet, it is worth keeping open while the firm gathers more information on demand and system fit.

Like Product B, it faces some cannibalization risk from the combined robot, but the option value of testing a stand-alone shuttering robot likely still exceeds the cost of keeping it on the market for now.
